1. Viridian Central Park, City Walk – 1BR, AED 8,500/month
2. Downtown Views 2 – 2BR, AED 8,000/month

Could you please send me photos or videos of these apartments and let me know when they are available for viewing? If everything looks suitable, I’m ready to proceed.
